favorites.title: I Didn't Mean to Haunt You
favorites.blurb: This album was my gateway drug to more experimental and maximalist music, and it holds a special place in my heart for that. I'm also a sucker for a good concept album.

favorites.title: Imaginal Disk
favorites.blurb: Just missed out on the #1 spot, but in my opinion its the best pop album ever made. I feel like I'm floating everytime I listen to it.

favorites.title: Ants From Up There
favorites.blurb: The instrumentation is so lush and the songwriting is just something else, you can feel the raw emotion in every song.

favorites.title: To Pimp a Butterfly
favorites.blurb: This album is so unbelievably well written both musically and lyrically, I wrote a philosophy paper on it back in college.

favorites.title: Emotion
favorites.blurb: Synth pop perfection, just banger after banger after banger.

favorites.title: American Idiot
favorites.blurb: A childhood favorite of mine that still holds up. Like I said before, I'm a sucker for a good concept album.

favorites.title: Vanisher, Horizon Scraper
favorites.blurb: The musical ideas on this album are so ambitious, and Quadeca executes them so well. He's come a long way from YouTube diss tracks.

favorites.title: Where the Light Is: Live in Los Angeles
favorites.blurb: I'm not typically one for live albums but the guitar playing here is just so unreal. In my opinion, John Mayer is the best guitarist of my generation.

favorites.title: good kid, m.A.A.d city
favorites.blurb: Such vivid storytelling in music this good shouldn't be possible. It's why I think Kendrick's the GOAT when it comes to rap.

favorites.title: Continuum
favorites.blurb: Incredible songwriting and guitar playing, with a really comforting and relaxing sound.

recommendation.title: I Love My Computer
recommendation.blurb: One of the first electronic albums that I really got into, and it's been a favorite ever since. iPod Touch sounds so nostalgic even though it came out last year.

recentListen.title: Love & Tears
recentListen.blurb: I'd never heard of this artist before but I saw the VMA performance of STORM II and was blown away. The whole album is just as good.
